Don't Stop Believing: An 80s Prom Experience

Doors: 6 PM
More Info
Dust off the aqua net, spike your hair, and get ready to party like it’s 1989!

Whether you’re rolling with your ride-or-die crew, going stag, or bringing a hot date, it’s time to squeeze into those neon ruffles, velvet tuxes, and blinding sequins. The ultimate, ’80s Prom Experience is crashing the legendary 9:30 Club—and it is going to be totally rad!

Your host for this nostalgic time-machine is the one and only Roxy Rio from local 80s band legends, The Legwarmers! Prepare to tear up the dance floor to the decade's biggest anthems from the likes of Madonna, Duran Duran, Bon Jovi, Whitesnake, The Bangles, & more. Flash your best smile at the retro photo station, compete to be crowned Prom Queen & King, prepare to battle it out during our “dance-off,” and snag a classic corsage at the merch booth to make it extra official.

Zero curfews. Zero chaperones. Zero excuses.
